Watch a 45-second walkthrough

Walkthrough: name the clip and version, add a timecode and a specific requested change, then copy or download the sheet. The cafe example is fictional. Narration uses a computer-generated voice.

Less guessing.
More useful notes.

Use this with your usual review link, shared document, or email. The builder organizes the words; your video stays wherever it already lives.

Name the exact version

“C02, v03” gives the editor a reliable reference. Timecodes from an older cut may no longer line up.

Describe the change

Instead of “make it punchier,” try “00:03: cut the greeting and start with the product close-up.” Add the intended result when it helps.

Send one set of decisions

Choose one final approver. Resolve conflicting team requests before sending the review sheet. Label open questions clearly.

About your notes

The builder runs in your browser. It doesn’t send your project names, approver names, or feedback to ZERO, and it doesn’t save a draft across refreshes. Copy and download only when you’re ready. The hosting service may process ordinary website access logs.
